upstream_checks.message:
feat: add CIEL Faza 2-4 modules — NOEMA SoT, py_catalog, semantic dynamics, subsystem registry

New modules:
- src/ciel_sot_agent/noema_sot.py          — NOEMA global SoT aggregator
- src/ciel_sot_agent/subsystem_registry.py  — per-subsystem SQLite DB + NOEMA card manager
- src/ciel_sot_agent/semantic_calculator.py — Master Semantic Calculator (file-level energy)
- src/ciel_sot_agent/semantic_calculator_v2.py — extended energy model
- src/ciel_sot_agent/py_catalog.py          — Python file catalog with 4D tags + co-occurrence
- src/ciel_sot_agent/md_library.py          — MD library semantic information system
- src/ciel_sot_agent/diagnostics.py         — CIEL system health diagnostics
- scripts/build_file_wij.py                 — W_ij graph builder
- scripts/test_euler_perturbation.py        — Euler constraint perturbation recovery test
- scripts/sims/kepler_ciel_sim.py           — Kepler CIEL orbit simulator
- tests/test_py_catalog.py                  — py_catalog test suite

Integration artifacts:
- integration/subsystems/*/                 — 6 subsystem DB + NOEMA card directories
- integration/registries/file_universal_catalog.json — all-file semantic catalog
- integration/registries/file_wij_graph.json          — file crossref graph
- integration/registries/how_to_library.json          — HOW-TO library index
- integration/registries/md_library_index.json        — MD library index
- integration/registries/py_library_index.json        — Python library index
- integration/registries/timeline.json                — timeline vector (Faza 4)
- integration/reports/noema_sot_report.json           — NOEMA SoT live report
